objects.description: [Ramsay](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0458) can use [ipconfig](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0100) and [Arp](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0099) to collect network configuration information, including routing information and ARP tables.(Citation: Antiy CERT Ramsay April 2020)
objects.description_fa: [Ramsay](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0458) می‌تواند از [ipconfig](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0100) و [Arp](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0099) برای جمع‌آوری اطلاعات پیکربندی شبکه، از جمله اطلاعات مسیریابی و جداول ARPVE_RES استفاده کند.[[[CTI_0]RESERVE_0]RES. (Citation: Antiy CERT Ramsay April 2020)
